target.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-fable-5 to CLI allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`claude-fable-5` — a production Anthropic model — was missing from the CLI provider path (`extensions/anthropic/cli-constants.ts` + `cli-catalog.ts`), while the direct Anthropic provider path (`register.runtime.ts`) already has full support via `isAnthropicFable5Model()` / `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow()`.

Four metadata layers were missing, plus the `fable`/`fable-5` aliases weren't routed through the context/model-ref canonicalization paths:

| Layer | File | Consequence |
|-------|------|-------------|
| allowlist | `cli-constants.ts` | `openclaw configure` cannot select fable-5 |
| aliases | `cli-constants.ts` | `fable` / `fable-5` aliases unresolvable |
| label | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to bare `${id} (Claude CLI)` |
| context window | `cli-catalog.ts` | Falls back to 200K instead of 1M |
| context/model-ref canonicalization | `claude-model-refs.ts`, `prepare.ts` | Bare `fable` alias uses 200K fallback instead of 1M |

This is the same root cause as #100572: a new model was registered in the direct API path but the CLI path's independently-maintained constants were not updated.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add fable-5 entries to the four CLI metadata layers **and** route the `fable` family alias through both canonicalization paths:

1. `claude-model-refs.ts`: add `fable: "claude-fable-5"` to `DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL_BY_FAMILY` so `resolveClaudeCliAnthropicModelRefs("claude-cli/fable")` returns the correct 1M reference instead of falling through to `CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL_ALIASES["fable"]` which returns bare `"fable"`
2. `prepare.ts`: add `fable`/`fable-5` aliases to `CLAUDE_CLI_CONTEXT_MODEL_ALIASES` so context budgeting doesn't fall to the 200K default
3. `cli-migration.test.ts`: update 3 migration test expectations to include `sonnet-5`/`fable-5` entries produced by the updated allowlist

## User Impact

- `openclaw configure` can now select `claude-fable-5` for the Claude CLI provider
- Aliases `fable` / `fable-5` / `claude-fable-5` resolve with correct 1M context window (was 200K)
- Model picker shows the friendly label "Claude Fable 5 (Claude CLI)"
- Context budgeting and config seeding preserve the Fable 5 1M reference, not the 200K fallback

## Evidence

- 5 files, +26/-4 lines (3 source + 2 lines, 1 test +14 lines)
- Unit tests: `cli-migration.test.ts` 15/15, `prepare.test.ts` 64/64, full `extensions/anthropic` 118/118
- All 197 tests passed
- oxlint clean, format check passed
- Build: `pnpm build` clean

### Real Behavior Proof

Verified all integration points with a script importing production modules directly via `tsx`:

**Context/model-ref canonicalization** (the new fix): `resolveClaudeCliAnthropicModelRefs("claude-cli/fable")` → `rewriteRef = anthropic/claude-fable-5` (not the old bare `fable`); `resolveKnownAnthropicModelRef("claude-cli/fable")` → `anthropic/claude-fable-5`. Opus/sonnet/haiku canonicalization confirmed no regression.

**Context budget aliases**: `CLAUDE_CLI_CONTEXT_MODEL_ALIASES` includes `fable → claude-fable-5` and `fable-5 → claude-fable-5`.

**Catalog entries**: `buildClaudeCliCatalogEntries()` includes `claude-fable-5` with 1,000,000 context window, "Claude Fable 5 (Claude CLI)" label, reasoning=true, text+image input, 2576px large-image tier.

```
$ npx tsx proof-101453.mjs

═══ 1. CLI Allowlist ═══
  ✓ claude-fable-5 in default allowlist
  Allowlist refs: claude-cli/claude-fable-5 ✓

═══ 2. CLI Model Aliases ═══
  ✓ fable → "fable" (passes bare name to CLI)
  ✓ fable-5 → claude-fable-5
  ✓ claude-fable-5 → claude-fable-5

═══ 3. Model-Ref Canonicalization ═══
  ✓ claude-cli/fable → rewriteRef = anthropic/claude-fable-5
  ✓ claude-cli/fable-5 → rewriteRef = anthropic/claude-fable-5
  ✓ resolveKnownAnthropicModelRef('claude-cli/fable') → anthropic/claude-fable-5
  ✓ opus/sonnet/haiku canonicalization — no regression

═══ 4. Catalog Entries ═══
  ✓ claude-fable-5 in catalog entries
  ✓ catalog name = "Claude Fable 5 (Claude CLI)"
  ✓ context window = 1,000,000 (1M)
  ✓ large-image tier maxSidePx = 2576

══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Passed: 22  Failed: 0
  Result: ✓ ALL PASSED
══════════════════════════════════════════════
```

Environment: Linux, Node v24.13.1, commit 5f2437eadb, branch fix/gap-claude-cli-fable5-catalog
What was not tested: End-to-end `openclaw configure` interactive flow (requires Claude CLI subscription environment)
